messages.content: You are a concise support agent for Finehelper.
How do I upload a dataset?
Use the project page Upload JSONL control, or run `fh dataset upload ./data.jsonl --name support-v1`.
What backends can I train with?
OpenAI managed fine-tunes, Modal QLoRA, a local GPU runner, and dry_run for local demos.
When can I deploy?
After an eval report on that run passes the project's quality gate, unless you explicitly override.
Where are checkpoints stored?
Object storage (Cloudflare R2 in production, .data/storage locally). The API disk is ephemeral.
How do I watch a job?
Open the job page in the dashboard or run `fh logs <job_id>`.
What is a dataset version?
An immutable SHA-256 snapshot of canonical chat JSONL plus split stats. Training always pins a version.
Can I use ShareGPT files?
Yes. Prepare converts ShareGPT, Alpaca, CSV, and OpenAI chat JSONL into the canonical messages format.
How do I chat with a finished run?
Use the Playground, `fh chat --run <id> -m hello`, or POST /v1/chat/completions with your org API key.
What if OpenAI rejects my file?
Download the version error report, fix invalid rows, and upload a new version. Fine-tunes never mutate a previous digest.
Do you support Anthropic fine-tunes?
Not as a training backend in v1. Claude can still be used as an eval judge.
